realtime_memories.content: portfolio-website (Vite + React) is for "Tanisha Brahma" (SOC / detection engineering / applied cryptography). GitHub repo: github.com/Junecoderr/portfolio-website (public, origin/main), gh CLI authenticated as myselfRaifMondal. Implementation is sourced from the user's Claude Design project "Tanisha Brahma - Portfolio" (fb82127e-3d38-4094-a6ff-d8e7809dbd8, read via DesignSync); an earlier "Security Portfolio" design project was superseded. Site is a 5-route SPA (home/work/case/about/contact) driven by React state, no router library.

Stack: three.js only (gsap dropped — scroll-reveal is plain IntersectionObserver). LatticeScene.jsx is a config-driven WebGL glass-node background — must stay position:fixed, not absolute, or it stretches to full page scroll height. Preloader is a deliberate addition on top of the imported design (not from the original), themed to the site's blue/violet/magenta palette; simplified on 2026-08-18 to just a pulsing brand orb + percent numeral after user feedback that the earlier bracket-spinner/rule/label version had design flaws.

IP boundary: when a design reference is a real third-party commercial site (e.g. noomo agency showcase), match the interaction mechanic with original assets only — never copy their licensed fonts/SVGs/code verbatim. The user's own Claude Design projects are their own content and are fine to implement in full.

No OPENROUTER_API_KEY configured on this machine — real image generation (generate-image skill) unavailable. Repo convention is labeled placeholder panels until a key is provided. A tanisha.png was manually dropped in the repo root by the user (a name-card/wordmark promo graphic, not a personal photo) but isn't wired into the current fully-typographic design.

Correction: this repo's project-scoped memory file lives at portfolio-website/.claude/memories/project_memory.json (cwd-relative), NOT at the parent Junecoderr/.claude/ one — a prior session edited the wrong file for many turns, which is why the cleanup hook kept re-firing. Always resolve the project_memory.json path relative to the current working directory.

Fixes shipped and pushed to main: (1) 2026-08-17 design review — corrected LatticeScene absolute-vs-fixed positioning bug and added missing --ls-h3/--ls-h4/--lh-body/--lh-h1/--lh-h2/--lh-h3 typography tokens, verified via build + Playwright. (2) 2026-08-18 contact info placeholders (email/Instagram/GitHub/Medium/location) replaced with real values across content.js and Contact.jsx, and home hero "Based" fact corrected Bengaluru -> Durgapur. (3) 2026-08-18 home-page lag root-caused: Home was the only route stacking a second full-canvas 2D animation (HeroCipherField, ~fillText-heavy glyph grid with mix-blend-mode: screen) on top of the always-on WebGL lattice — fixed by coarsening the glyph grid, lowering its frame budget, and pausing both HeroCipherField's and LatticeScene's rAF loops via visibilitychange when the tab is hidden. Commits: 3268de2, 6a88210.

User preference on footer copy: dislikes the legal-disclaimer tone ("All project names, figures and CVE identifiers on this site are illustrative") — replaced in Footer.jsx with a brand-value line: "Every claim on this site is one I can defend in an interview." General direction — favor confidence/credibility copy over disclaimers when editing site text. Not yet committed/pushed as of 2026-08-18T17:48.
